method: Each accepted file was downloaded, identified as a PDF, parsed with pdfinfo and pdftotext, sampled at the title/front matter and interior pages, measured from the downloaded bytes, and hashed locally with SHA-256. Internet Archive availability alone was not used as rights evidence.

rights_basis.pre_1931_us_publications: The U.S. Copyright Office states that all works published in the United States before January 1, 1931 are in the public domain.
rights_basis.federal_works: 17 U.S.C. section 105 generally excludes U.S. Government works from copyright protection, subject to statutory exceptions and separately owned material.

accepted.author_publisher: Water Resources Division, U.S. Geological Survey
accepted.rights_finding: USGS item page explicitly labels Sources/Usage as Public Domain.
accepted.inspection: Title and both pages parsed; contents cover map scale, distance, direction, bearings, compass use, and magnetic declination.

accepted.author_publisher: Edith Loring Fullerton; Doubleday, Page & Company
accepted.rights_finding: Published in the United States in 1905; copyright term expired. Rights conclusion is based on publication date and U.S. Copyright Office guidance, not the Archive listing.
accepted.inspection: Copyright and publication pages, contents, opening text, and interior cultivation pages parsed. The scan is complete and legible; historical chemical and pest-control advice needs current safety context.

accepted.author_publisher: Herbert A. Shearer; Frederick J. Drake & Company
accepted.rights_finding: Published in the United States in 1918; copyright term expired. Rights conclusion is independent of Archive metadata.
accepted.inspection: Title, 1918 copyright page, preface, contents, and interior tool, machinery, waterworks, and electrical pages parsed. Scan is complete; hazardous historical methods are labeled in catalog metadata.

accepted.rights_finding: Published in the United States no later than 1912; copyright term expired. The scan also states that no known copyright restrictions exist, but term expiry is the controlling evidence.
accepted.inspection: Title, copyright, contents, and interior illustrated project pages parsed. File is readable and substantively matches its title; projects require modern safety review.

accepted.author_publisher: George Redfield Spalding and U.S. Army Corps of Engineers; U.S. Government Printing Office
accepted.rights_finding: 1917 U.S. Government Printing Office publication and, independently, a U.S. publication from before 1931.
accepted.inspection: Title/front matter and interior topography, printing, coordinate, and reconnaissance pages parsed. Scan is complete; obsolete coordinate and military procedures are labeled historical.

rejected_or_deferred.title: NAHEMS Guidelines: Biosecurity
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Deferred for rights review: produced by Iowa State University under a USDA cooperative agreement, so federal hosting alone does not prove that every component is a U.S. Government work or redistributable.

rejected_or_deferred.title: Voice Radio Communications Guide for the Fire Service, second edition
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Deferred for rights review: the document credits a substantive partnership with the International Association of Fire Fighters and does not provide an edition-specific redistribution license.

rejected_or_deferred.title: The Weather Guide, sixth edition
rejected_or_deferred.reason: Deferred from the practical catalog because it is a 2012 regional weather/media reference for the San Diego forecast area, not broadly applicable preparedness guidance; embedded third-party material also needs review before self-hosting.
